parameters.name: SpecialKey
parameters.description: The ID of the app or Alibaba Cloud account. You can view your account ID on the [Account Management](https://account.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.15.343130a8sDi8cO#/secure) page.

parameters.name: SpecialType
parameters.description:
The type of the special throttling policy. Valid values:

*   **APP**
*   **USER**

parameters.name: TrafficControlId
parameters.description: The ID of the throttling policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi delete-traffic-special-control --traffic-control-id tf123456 --special-type APP --special-key 3382463 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DeleteTrafficSpecialControl --region cn-hangzhou --SpecialKey 3382463 --TrafficControlId tf123456 --SpecialType APP
